description_en: Bhājudhana Bāhāḥ is located to the west of Uku Bāhāḥ (LAL2260). It is located inside an L-shaped courtyard which can be accessed through a narrow underpass by a six storied building. Thebāhāḥis on the way to Thāpāhiṭī from Mahābuddha. The main monument building is a small structure attached to a residential building to the west. It is not visible from the main entrance; one must walk to the end of the long courtyard and turn right to find an adjacent courtyard. Together, they form an open L-shaped space. Bhājudhana Bāhāḥ is a branch of the Oku Bāhāh.The god house sits on a stone plinth raised above the ground. The main sanctum is constructed from timber and exhibits intricately carved door jambs and atoraṇa thā(the place fortoraṇa). Four corner posts have been carved to resemble the column that supports the three-tiered roofs, which in turn are covered with brass plates. The structure's pinnacle is missing. Behind the monument, there is a four-storey residential building with a projecting carved open window at the center flanked by two vertical lattice windows on either sides on the first floor. Above this, the second floor boasts a central and elaborately carved triple-opening window. The ground floor has a three-bayed colonnaded structure, and the central bay is occupied by this monument. In front of the monument, one can find adharmadhātujinālaya caitya(2 m high) and adharmadhātu maṇḍala(65 cm high) on a raised platform paved in stone.The structure of thisbāhāḥdiffers from otherbāhāḥof Patan; thisbāhāḥhas nokvāḥpāḥchẽ. The brass-clad roof of the temple is supported by struts that display images of Lokeśvaras. Previously, one could find an image of Amitābha inside the temple's sanctum, but this is presently at the home of one of the main authorities of thebāhāḥ. Atoraṇaabove the entrance of the sanctum shows Lokeśvara with Prajñāpāramitā to her right and another Lokeśvara to her left.Śākya(1994, 118-119) writes that the sanctum also contained wall paintings of Māyādevī, Cintāmaṇi Lokeśvara, Padmasaṃbhava, Harihariharivāhanalokeśvara, Uṣṇīṣavijaya, Āryatārā, Dhvajāgrakeyūrī and the first Bhīmarathārohaṇa. However, only three of them (Uṣṇīṣavijaya, Āryatārā and Padmasaṃbhava) are still there.Bhājudhana Śākya was a member of thesaṅghaof Oku Bāhāḥ and he established thisbāhāḥwith help of his elder brother Bhīmarāja and other family members. Bhājudhana had shop in Tibet where he sold gold jewellery. He established thisvihārausing the money he earned from his business. As a result, thisvihārais also called Hiraṇyalābha Vihāra. In NS 1027 (1907 CE), Bhājudhana established adharmadhātujinālaya caityain the courtyard. Two years later, he made a small god house and enshrined the image of Akṣobhya inside it.
description_ne: रुद्रवर्ण महाविहार, ओकुबाहा:को प्रवेशद्वारको पश्चिमपट्टि रहेको सानो गल्लीबाट भित्र पसेपछि भाजुधन विहारमा पुगिन्छ । यो ओकुबाहा:को शाखा विहार हो । ओकुबाहा:का त:ज: खलकका भाजुधन शाक्य नामका व्यक्तिले यो विहार निर्माण गरेका थिए । उनकै नामबाट यस विहारको नाम भाजुधन विहार रहेको हो । तिब्बतमा सुनको गहना बनाउने व्यवसायबाट कमाएको सम्पत्ति खर्च गरेर बनाएको हुनाले विहारको संस्कृत नाम हिरण्यलाभ विहार रहेको मानिन्छ । उनको त्यस काममा दाजु भीमराज र परिवारका अन्य सदस्यहरूले साथ दिएका थिए । भाजुधनले नेसं १०२७ (सन् १९०७) मा पहिले धर्मधातु जिनालय चैत्य बनाएका थिए । त्यसको दुई वर्षपछि नेसं १०२९ (सन् १९०९) मा सानो मन्दिर बनाएर अक्षोभ्य बुद्धको मूर्ति स्थापना गरी विहार बनाएका थिए ।यसलाई विहार भनिए पनि यहाँ कुनै क्वा:पा:छेँ छैन । चोकको पश्चिमपट्टि रहेको घरको भित्तामा टाँस्सिने गरी सानो मन्दिर बनाइएको छ । अग्लो पेटीमाथि बनाइएको मन्दिरमा तीन तहको पित्तलको छाना राखिएको छ । छानामाथि अहिले गजुर छैन । छानाको कार्नेसमा रञ्जना लिपिमा बौद्ध मन्त्र कुँदिएको छ । छानालाई अड्याउन विविध लोकेश्वर अंकित कलात्मक टुँडाल राखिएको छ । मन्दिरको गर्भगृहभित्र अमिताभ बुद्धको प्रतिमा स्थापना गरिएको थियो, तर अहिले चोरीको भयले विहारका जिम्मेवार व्यक्तिहरूले बुद्ध मूर्तिलाई घरभित्रै सुरक्षित राखेका छन् । गर्भगृहको ढोकामाथि काठको तोरण राखिएको छ । तोरणको बीचमा अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध र दायाँ-बायाँ प्रज्ञापारमिता र लोकेश्वर रहेका छन् । विहारको प्राङ्गणमा धर्मधातु जिनालय चैत्य र धर्मधातु मण्डल स्थापना गरिएको छ । विहारको दक्षिणपट्टि रहेको घरको भित्तामा मायादेवी, चिन्तामणि लोकेश्वर, पद्मसंभव, हरिहरिहरिवाहनलोकेश्वर, उष्णीषविजय, आर्यतारा, ध्वजाग्रकेयूरी र प्रथम भीमरथारोहणको चित्र लेखिएका थिए (Śākya 1994, 118-119) ।  तर अहिले उष्णीषविजय, आर्यतारा,  र पद्मसंभवको चित्र मात्र बाँकी छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Bhājudhana and his family members established the Dharmadhātu Jinālayacaitya.

historical_events.event_name: Construction of a temple for Kvāḥpāḥdyaḥ
historical_events.event_description: Bhājudhana and his family constructed the temple and enshrined Akṣobhya as thekvāḥpāḥdyaḥ.
